import json,re
d=json.load(open('products/services/topcoder-fit/active-challenges.json'))
print(type(d).__name__, len(d))
items=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('data',d)
for c in items[:10]:
    desc=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>|\s+',' ',str(c.get('description','')))
    print('---');print(c.get('id'),'|',c.get('name'),'|',c.get('status'),'|',(c.get('type') if isinstance(c.get('type'),str) else c.get('type')),'|',c.get('track'))
    print('prizes',json.dumps(c.get('prizeSets'))[:300]);print('dates',c.get('registrationEndDate'),c.get('submissionEndDate'),c.get('endDate'),'reg',c.get('numOfRegistrants'),'sub',c.get('numOfSubmissions'))
    print('terms',json.dumps(c.get('terms'))[:300]);print('tags',c.get('tags') or c.get('skills'))
    low=desc.lower()
    for k in ['ai ','llm','generative','chatgpt','copilot','artificial']:
        for m in re.finditer(k,low):
            print('  AI>',desc[max(0,m.start()-120):m.start()+160]);break
    print('desc',desc[:500])
